notes.title: Maintenance & Update Note
notes.content:
❗Commanders, servers will be undergoing maintenance for update.

Maintenance schedule: 2024/05/16, 3:00 UTC

Duration: 2-3 hours

------------------------------------------------

📝Update note:

➡️Godfall Class Flagship

Flagship Skills

Stardust Storm: The flagship triggers 'Stardust Storm' every 5 turns, dealing additional weapon damage to enemy ships with a chance to inflict 'Sluggish' status on affected targets when entering into a fight.
Sluggish Status: Reduces ship attack speed for a certain number of turns (applies only to Commander fleets).

Hawkeye Precision: Increases weapon damage to all enemy ships. If the target ship is under 'Sluggish' status, this effect is further increased when entering into a fight.
Spacetime Counter: Increases attack speed and shield damage of allied ships for 10 turns (20-turn cooldown) when entering into a fight.

➡️New Starglow Flagship Weapons and Spacetime Flagship Component Set
Dominion Series Ships

Rover Gunship

Assault Amplification: Increases all ships' attack in the fleet for a certain number of turns when entering into a fight.

Ravager Frigate

Guerrilla Strategy:Increases all ships' Accuracy in the fleet for a certain number of turns when entering into a fight.

Wing Cavalry Destroyer

Phantom Trace: Increases all ships' Evasion in the fleet for a certain number of turns when entering into a fight.

Pathfinder Light Cruiser

Crit Shield:Reduces critical damage received by the ship.

Stalker Battle Cruiser

Agility Boost：Grants additional Evasion to the ship.

Dominion Dreadnought

Hawkeye Precision:Grants Accuracy to the ship.

Fleet Tradition

Will to Command: Increases leadership count

➡️ New Ship Weapons and Components

Gryphon Cannon

Overkill: Attacks have a chance to trigger a guaranteed follow-up strike with increased damage.

Talon Laser

Melting Beam: Attacks have a chance to deal extra damage equal to a percentage of the target’s remaining shield and gain 20% shield penetration. Increases critical damage if the target has no shield.

Redwolf Missile

Deep Break: Attacks have a chance to strike 1 extra target for increased damage and increase weapon attack speed for the next turn.

Grayhawk Drone

Dampening Cluster: Attacks have a chance to strike 3 lowest-HP targets and increase critical damage.

Basalt Series Universal Components

Hull Fortification (5): Increases ship HP.

Shieldbreaking Assault (9): When fleet remaining HP is below a certain percentage of max HP, weapons gain additional shield penetration.

Note: some these names and terms might change in the future

📝Update note:

➡️Chaos Battlefield
1. During the Chaos Battlefield event, commanders can customize the number of participating ships in the Fleet Configuration screen using currently available blueprints. Commanders who uploaded the fleet data will be registered to the event. 
2. After the Registration Stage, the event will enter the Election Stage. During the Election Stage, all the registered commanders will participate in a double-elimination match. Promoted commanders will be qualified for the final match.
3. The Final Match will be based on single-elimination matches. The Rank Reward will depend on the final ranking.
4. During the Final Matches, commanders can use GEC or Chaos Wager Ticket to place bets on the coming matches. When the battle ends, the bettors of the winning side will, at a certain proportion, receive all the wagers from the defeated side.
5. Commanders registered for the event can select and ban a perk in the Battlefield Buff list. Selected buffs will apply to your fleets in battle. When you ban the same buff that your opponent selected, your opponent's selected buff will be deactivated. 

➡️New Flagship-Asgard Class
1. Flagship Skills:
Eternity Echo: When the ships in the Van Row of the fleet still have Shield left, the Flagship will restore the Shield back to the max value every 15 rounds in battle. 
Shield Guardian: Increases Shield for the fleet Van Row by 30% in battle
Hivemind Laser: Increases fleet Laser and Drone damage
Fleet Dominance: Grants extra Leadership for every Admiral level
2. Added Eternity Flagship weapons and Horn Flagship suits

➡️Other Optimizations
1. Added display for the amount of stealth ships in the main screen
2. Added new filters for Flagship component effects
3. Optimized the rewards in Nova Pass. New rewards will be implemented in the next Nova Pass
4. Optimized the rewards in the Points Shop

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Event: Battle of Hydra[/h1]

- Cross-server war
Join a force and collaborate with your allies to take the Hydra Crystal Cores in the Crimson Court galaxy. Fight your way through as you become the final winner of the grand battle.
- Plunder Resources 
As the main resource of the event, you need to secure the transport routes of your force’s Crystal Cores while you prevent commanders of other forces from taking over more Crystal Cores. 
- Powerful Force Buffs
Complete force missions to level up your force and unlock powerful buffs. Certain special events will even trigger unique missions to allow you to unlock extra buffs
- Time-limited Event Ships
The Crystal Cores acquired by your force can be transformed into force ships that will help you secure your victory.
- Hydra Series Ships
- 3 new Dreadnoughts in Hydra style. Only the winning force will receive the right to build these powerful monsters.

notes.title: Developer Q&A Answers
notes.content:
Commanders, the devs have answered your questions.

Enjoy the read!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375902/d3977a9d0ae7eef9db472ad652b481b4d0bd48ee.jpg[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q Can the “Viking Class” ships used by the NPC be updated to Class 1 or Class 2 of players ships?
#A We're working on implementing radar pirates that are more powerful and with more rewards.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q We need another weekly event to be able to get Solar Dust and Time Matrix… there are three things that are important that require them for upgrades. What happened to the other tasks that offered them as rewards?
#A We are currently working on this!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q Now that you guys have released t4 dreads with power totals over 2 billion per fleet… are you guys planning on bringing the Elite Pirates up to parity? Along with better rewards?
#A We will adjust the gameplay on the galaxy map, including elite pirates, planet exploration and legion missions.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q How are we supposed to complete the task of 10 exploration missions per day when only 6 are available. And add to that that you can only do 3 every 8 hours of the 6 allotted?
#A Exploration attempts will restore by 1 every 2 hours, you can also head to different solar systems to explore more planets.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q We need more defensive modules: shield modules and health modules would change the way game is balanced. The introduction of battle units, crystal modules and flagships did nothing to improve the weapons, everyone is still using missiles. 
#A Missiles are not the most powerful weapons right now, you can try some other configurations.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q Can you guys remove the red reward icon notification off of the timed battle simulation trials. I constantly am annoyed by it.
#A This will be fixed soon!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q (1)How to calculate damage when shield armor and evasion are working on enemy’s ship?
(2)How often is the merging event? It’s been a long time since last merge.
#A 1. Evasion is the first to be calculated, then the system will calculate Shield and Armor.
2. It is often decided by our operation team, no specific schedule.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q Was it intentional to have the purple fragments set at 60 pieces for combining from the timed battle simulation? The prize pool is so diluted with other prizes not to mention there seems to be 55-60 different types to collect. Seems like a huge over sight…
#A We will release more Battle Units in different events.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q When are you going to fix legions?
#A You can invite more Alliance members to lower the difficulties.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q There are a lot of players who skip going from standard to elite servers. They lower their development to your threshold then move to next server and ballon back to 1 billion.
Are you going to do anything about this situation?
I have a suggestion make level 5 and 6 stations move to elite regardless of development numbers.
#A Thank you for your feedback, we will try to optimize this.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q When are you going to release a Erinyes ship point reset?
You said you would put the graviton core in the events of the first season. But we still haven't seen anything.
Better / varied / or chooseable rewards for Elite servers.
#A We are working on all three of these questions, coming soon!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q Why can you not demote, modules?
#A We can try optimizing the recyclings of your modules. And yes, the module boxes do contain Kraken damage modules, you can also equip both the kraken damage modules along with the new modules
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q How many Elite 3M, 4M and 7M pirates are there in a Galaxy? What to do to generate more of them?
#A The refresh rate and rewards of elite pirates are all random, you can click on the elite pirate to check the potential rewards.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q When you are not in an alliance or an alliance without territory, you can't warp to another star system unless it's neutral. I am currently in an alliance with no territory, so I can only jump to other systems. No other alliances will accept me because my numbers are too, low, I get it.
#A We are planning to offer better developing environment for this kind of players.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Q Many including me are wondering if there will be a level 7 station? Will the current flagship updates be so hard to attend without paying?
#A Building upgrade is now in planning. You can get Flagship through in-game events for free.

notes.title: Update: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch note:

📌Battle Units[/b]
The Battle Units are the first onboard co-commanding battle system series developed by Cannon Defense Corporation. It is a visualized, comprehensive synergetic commanding collection, aiming to provide efficient data analysis and processing to a whole fleet to increase the fleet's combat and survival abilities.
1.Each fleet can install up to 6 Battle Units (3 Weapon Units and 3 Defensive Units)
2.Naval Battle Unit have 5 qualities, white, green, blue, purple, and orange
3.Each Battle Unit can be upgraded with certain materials to greatly boost the effect
4.Collect various Battle Units and upgrade them to provide your fleets with formidable Buffs
5.You can obtain Battle Units by participating in Limited Battle Simulation and other in-game     events
6.Commanders can select the Battle Units with various attributes to build up their own powerful fleets

[b]📌New Erinyes Admirals[/b]
1.Josef Melouney
2.Barrotte the Servant
They possess the mysterious technology of the Erinyes Astral Weapons, thus able to boost the attack of specific weapons.
Barrotte the Servant can be recruited from the Naval Academy, for Josef Melouney, please pay attention to the in-game event.

[b]📌Combat Crystal[/b]
A newly cracked An’Pin technology that will enable commanders to increase the attack for any type of weapons once installed in the building’s core. For any more details, please keep an eye on the imperial announcement.

[b]📌Ember Skills[/b]
Added two new skills for Alliance Ember that can only be cast by the Ember operator. The skills can only be used on the selected solar system while Ember is not in a battle.
Warship Projection: use Ember energy to project the Defense Fleets into a selected battlefield. The Defense Fleets will return to Ember once the battle is over.
Dispersed Torrent: use Ember energy to deal AOE damage to all enemy fleets according to the projected Defense Fleets on the battlefield. 

[b]📌Flagship Component[/b]
Added a 3-set bonus for Flagship Components. The set bonus for Flagship Components is now easier to activate, and two different bonuses can be activated at the same time.

notes.title: Developer Q&A Answers
notes.content:
Commanders, the devs have answered your questions.

Enjoy the read!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375902/d3977a9d0ae7eef9db472ad652b481b4d0bd48ee.jpg[/img]

-----------------------------------------------

#Q Will there be a new event for this year?

#A We'll keep working on bringing new events to you. You can also share your good ideas with us if you have any.

-----------------------------------------------

#Q Is there any plan to bring in the 1v1, 2v2, 5v5 pvp contests? If yes, then when?

#A We're now assessing the feasibilities of such gameplay. If you have any ideas, you're welcome to share

-----------------------------------------------

#Q When are we getting new day-to-day events?

#A We will gradually adjust the rewards in these old events to make them more valuable and worth your time.

-----------------------------------------------

#Q 1. When are you going to make the graviton core accessible again in an event? 

2. Are you going to make Battleship Constantine holofunctions more accessible? 

3. Are you going to put new avatar on the game for more diversity? The same player images have been available for years, a little something new would be welcome.

#A 1. Gravition core-related events will be released in the first season

2. We will adjust the events very soon.

3. Yes, new avatars are on their way.

-----------------------------------------------

#Q When for the new adjutant?

#A Coming in the first season.

-----------------------------------------------

#Q When are the upgraded golden kraken ships coming out?

#A We are now discussing if it's necessary or possible to release more powerful Kraken ships. If you have any good suggestions, please let us know!

-----------------------------------------------

#Q How to get older, but important stuff like railgun mods, railgun fragments for research, railgun damage modules?

#A Most stuff will be released according to the player's game progress or the server cycle. If you find anything that might be unreasonable, please let us know

-----------------------------------------------

#Q Will we ever get a way to exchange all the excess erinyes pieces?

#A We will assess this and fight for a more reasonable way to exchange the pieces

-----------------------------------------------

#Q Can we get the full equation for calculating damage in combat ie damage buffs to damage true damage resistance armor?

#A Sorry, this is our trade secret and we cannot tell you that.

-----------------------------------------------

#Q Could we get a feature to see how many players are online and offline in alliance chat?

#A We have no such plan for now.

-----------------------------------------------

#Q I would really love more opportunities to get fragments for the new ship models. Will this occur?

#A Please participate in the game events!

-----------------------------------------------

#Q Can we get Jump Server ticket like Change Name tickets please.

#A We have no such plan for now

notes.title: 5th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Today is a day for celebration, Commanders! Nova Empire is five years old!

To commemorate this galactic day, we are announcing a [b]major update[/b] featuring a new Flagship feature! See more details below! The exact release date will be revealed soon.

For an exclusive trailer, head on over to the [url=https://www.facebook.com/NovaEmpireGame]Nova Empire Facebook Page[/url] to view the trailer and for a chance to win some rewards.

To celebrate the festivities, five lucky commenters below will also have a chance to win a 15 day speedup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375902/2a0d8686f6c611fc13b234c140404f64923cf923.png[/img]

-------------------------------------------------

Check out the list of new features below!

[b]Exploration Detachment[/b]


[list]
[*] After constructing the Naval Academy, commanders can assign Admirals to complete Exploration Detachment.
[*] When the station reaches Lv.6, commanders can get Flagships by completing special Exploration Detachment.
[*] Regular missions will be refreshed over time, complete Regular missions daily to get various rewards.
[*] Match Admiral’s traits to the mission requirement will increase the points earned from the mission, the higher the points, the better the rewards. 
[*] Complete certain missions to obtain mission logs, and learn background story through these logs.
[/list]
 
[b]Flagship[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375902/7ae17789c3b908e34f4bf21afd99ad018cb12e46.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Commanders can get Flagships by completing special Exploration Detachment. 
[*] Each Admiral can command 1 Flagship without any Leadership cost. 
[*] Assigning a corresponding Admiral to a Flagship will unlock its exclusive skills. 
[*] Flagships will be automatically refitted once returned to the Dock without any repairmen. However, a destroyed Flagship during battles will not leave any wreckage behind.
[/list]

[b]Component Production[/b]
[list]
[*] Improve the Flagship’s attribute by installing components. You can also unlock special perks by installing components of the same series.
[*] You can use special materials to produce randomly produce various components.
[*] You can receive some materials by dismantling your spare components.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375902/18e34e7c360617c340b760429f9b2501ca1ac8a2.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Galaxy Wars!
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,

Some of you may have already noticed during gameplay... But, in case you haven't yet, we have a new feature in Nova Empire—Galaxy Wars!

Here are a few points to help you understand the new Galaxy War better:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375902/5003ea8b30d605fac3d0b8eecdfc75f9674dd17f.jpg[/img]

🚀
1. Energy Crystals
Participate in the Deep Space Tournament to get tons of GEC and Energy Crystals!
You can have up to 4000 Energy Crystals to use during Galaxy Wars.

🚀
2. Donation
You can donate in Alliance HQ or Outposts to build and level up the Alliance Defense Amplifiers, and get GEC at the same time.
You can donate with or without an Alliance and can donate to any Alliance you see fit. But it is better to donate to the Alliance HQ with the permission to build the Ember;
The max level of a Defense Amplifier is 3. You can build up to 4 Alliance HQs and 3 Outposts.

🚀
3. Ember
Before a Galaxy War, the top three Alliances with the most Alliance HQs on the server Ranking list will have be able to build the "Ember."
The Alliance building the "Ember" must have 4 Defense Amplifiers before the "Ember" can be built.
Donating Energy Crystals to the 4 Defense Amplifiers can improve the rank and level of "Ember."

🚀
4. The lowest level of the 4 Defense Amplifiers will determine the Rank of Ember
The Amount of Energy Crystals required for Defense Amplifiers:
Lv.1: 8000
Lv.2: 16000
Lv.3: 40000
